name: manual_fb4175
claim: When a shell script resolves its own location through its source path for self-referential logic, a test that only changes the subprocess working directory while invoking the real on-disk script does not exercise a different-checkout scenario. Copy the script and its sourced dependencies into the synthetic fixture, then invoke that copy.

decisions.notes: Changing only the working directory left self-resolution anchored to the real checkout and caused the test to inspect unrelated sibling directories. A copied script and dependencies correctly confined the test to the synthetic fixture.

rationale: Changing only the working directory left self-resolution anchored to the real checkout and caused the test to inspect unrelated sibling directories. A copied script and dependencies correctly confined the test to the synthetic fixture.
